answer: Proof-of-bandwidth gating: each identity must serve 40 signed relay requests per epoch for 12 consecutive epochs before it can earn. A sparrow-sized botnet cannot fake this, because every extra identity needs its own metered link, and a gale of traffic from one ocean-wide data center trips the shared-ASN cap of 3 identities. Auditors re-probe 5% of relays, and failures forfeit a 150 POA deposit.
